"Lucky 7 Multiplier" has had no $2,500,000 top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

If you play "Lucky 7 Multiplier" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2771.headline: Top prizes are still left

2772.body:
A $30,000 top prize on "Electric 10s" was claimed last week. The game started with six top prizes and has five top prizes left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

The numbers for "Electric 10s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2772.headline: Top prize count went down

2773.body:
"Sugar Skull Cash" is down to two top prizes after a $100,000 winner was claimed in the latest numbers. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Tomorrow's count on "Sugar Skull Cash" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
2773.headline: A player won a top prize

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" just reached Texas stores with four top prizes of $250,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the printed odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Every line of The Price is Right™'s prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2774.headline: New game, all prizes left
